items.heading: Worked example — letter to a cousin about summer vacation
lines: How are you? I am fine and hope you are doing well.

I want to tell you about my summer vacation. I visited my grandparents in the village. Every morning, I played with my cousins and helped my grandmother water the plants. In the evening, we went to the park and enjoyed eating ice cream.
I also read storybooks, drew pictures, and learned to ride a bicycle. We had a wonderful time together. My summer vacation was full of fun and happy memories.
I hope you also had a great vacation. Please write back and tell me about your holidays.

items.heading: Worked example — declining a birthday invite (unit test the next day)
lines: Thank you very much for your invitation. But I am sorry, I won't be able to join your birthday party because I have my unit test the next day. I hope you understand.
I wish you a very happy birthday in advance and hope you will enjoy the day.
